question: Among the following, whose autobiography is ‘My Confession’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Leo Tolstoy.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Leo Tolstoy **is known primarily for having written the masterpieces War and Peace, which are commonly regarded as among the finest novels ever written.
 
• **A Confession, or My Confession**, is a short work on the subject of melancholia, philosophy and religion by the Russian novelist Leo Tolstoy. 
 
• It was written in 1879 to 1880, when Tolstoy was in his early fifties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi__, commonly known as Bapu, was an Indian lawyer, anti-colonial nationalist, and political ethicist who employed nonviolent resistance to lead the successful campaign for India's independence from British rule.
 
• __Adolf Hitler w__as an Austrian-born German politician who was the dictator of Germany from 1933 until his death in 1945. He rose to power as the leader of the Nazi Party, becoming the chancellor in 1933 
 
• **__Nelson Mandela__** is known for several things, but perhaps he is best known for successfully leading the resistance to South Africa's policy of apartheid in the 20th century.
